That's similar to a greedy algorithm where we allocate tokens one by one, each time choosing the segment with highest importance / (current allocation + 1) (since next allocated position is the number of tokens already allocated plus 1). However, note that they say "While budget remains, give one token to the segment maximizing importance divided by its next allocated position." So we simulate allocation one token at a time. After loop, compute by_name dict. Return {"allocations": allocations, "by_name": by_name, "total": budget}.

Make sure to handle cases where budget equals sum of minimums: no remaining tokens, allocations are minimums.
